import java.io.*;
public class test {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String s = br.readLine() + "  ";
        int maxRun = 0, parenCount = 0, currentRun = 0;
        int pos = 0;
        int n = s.length();
        boolean insideParentheses = false;
        
        while (pos < n) {
            char ch = s.charAt(pos);
            
            if (ch == '(') {
                // Check if currentRun has a word before entering parentheses
                if (!insideParentheses && currentRun > 0) {
                    if (currentRun > maxRun) maxRun = currentRun;
                    currentRun = 0;
                }
                insideParentheses = true;
                pos++;
            } else if (ch == ')') {
                // End of parentheses
                if (insideParentheses && currentRun > 0) {
                    parenCount++;
                    currentRun = 0;
                }
                insideParentheses = false;
                pos++;
            } else if (ch == '_') {
                // Word separator
                if (insideParentheses) {
                    if (currentRun > 0) parenCount++;
                } else {
                    if (currentRun > maxRun) maxRun = currentRun;
                }
                currentRun = 0;
                pos++;
            } else if ((ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z')) {
                currentRun++;
                pos++;
            } else {
                pos++;
            }
        }
        
        // Check final word if not inside parentheses
        if (!insideParentheses && currentRun > maxRun) {
            maxRun = currentRun;
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxRun + " " + parenCount);
    }
}
